evidence_records.claim: TNPA tender scope specified a 7 MW renewable-energy plant and 6 MWh battery energy-storage system; annexure identifies approximately 6,991 kW solar PV and 9 kW vertical-axis wind turbines.
evidence_records.applicability: Procurement scope only. Award, construction, commissioning, operating output, current availability and current battery state are not verified by this record.
evidence_records.notes: Do not label this asset operational.

evidence_records.claim: The September 2025 port connection-capacity study reports 19 MVA, approximately 17.1 MW, estimated spare capacity and low screening connection risk for Ngqura.
evidence_records.applicability: Pre-feasibility port-level estimate; not a utility offer or guaranteed capacity at a specific feeder, point of connection, time or operating condition.
evidence_records.notes: Original apparent-power value reported as 19 MVA; the study's corresponding MW estimate is recorded here.

evidence_records.claim: The September 2025 South African shore-power demand study reports Durban has the highest estimated shore-power demand among the assessed national ports.
evidence_records.applicability: Comparative demand statement. This does not quantify Ngqura demand or establish an hourly load profile.
evidence_records.notes: Durban is retained as a future stress-test comparator, not substituted for Ngqura.

evidence_records.claim: Microsoft Project Natick Phase 2 reports a 240 kW subsea data-centre module with 12 racks and 864 servers.
evidence_records.unit: MW IT/facility module reference as reported by Microsoft
evidence_records.applicability: Scale reference only. Not a proposed Ngqura load, not a normalized PUE comparison and not evidence of a commercial design requirement.
evidence_records.notes: Actual power boundary and workload-normalized performance must be pinned before quantitative comparisons.

evidence_records.claim: Bathymetry, seabed habitat, metocean baseline, cable corridor, marine protected-area intersections, thermal plume and permitting suitability for a subsea compute module are not established by this case.
evidence_records.applicability: No subsea site selection or environmental suitability conclusion is permitted.
evidence_records.notes: Unknowns are blocking inputs, not zero-valued impacts.

assets.notes: Tender annexure specifies approximately 6,991 kW solar PV; commissioning and operating state are not verified.
Tender annexure specifies approximately 9 kW vertical-axis wind; commissioning and operating state are not verified.
Battery inverter power, usable capacity, chemistry, efficiency, degradation and commissioning state are unknown.
A port-level screening estimate is not the connection rating of a specific feeder.

grid.notes: Obtain current feeder data and a formal study before allocating any compute or shore-power load.

workload.notes: The Natick 240 kW figure is a comparison reference, not a site proposal. Workload trace, latency, migration, data-sovereignty and availability requirements are not yet supplied.
